items.text: A research or PhD career after an MBA suits people who enjoy questions that take months to answer, and the paths lead to teaching and academic research, industry research and consulting, so the sensible start is to test it with a small paper or project before committing years.
Try one research project, talk to doctoral students, compare funding and outcomes and choose between academic and industry research paths.
Read the current official notices and ask the supervisor about funding and workload.
